title: MaxMin-RLHF: Alignment with Diverse Human Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating diverse human populations with conflicting stylistic preferences (e.g., positive sentiment vs. conciseness, elementary vs. PhD reading levels, friendly vs. unfriendly tone) and evaluating the model's performance and pairwise win rates on the minority group's preferences across varying majority-to-minority training data ratios.
